newsitem.title: UK: BG Berlin sets German car loan transaction.
newsitem.headline: BG Berlin sets German car loan transaction.

text.p: Bankgesellschaft Berlin has invited a group of banks to participate in a 50 million mark tranche of a 200 million mark programme backed by German car loan receivables, BGB said in a statement on Wednesday.
The transaction has an amortizing structure with an expected maturity of approximately 37 months, a legal maturity of approximately 69 months and an average maturity of approximately 24 mths.
The margin is one-month mark LIBOR + 38 basis points.
"This will be the first asset-backed transaction of a German bank appearing as seller of receivables," the statement said, adding: "The market has already shown a strong interest in the transaction."
